query: What IRB, data-use agreement elements, retention policy for linkage keys, and role-based access controls are essential for instrument logs and pseudonymized patient linkages?

response.query: What IRB, data-use agreement elements, retention policy for linkage keys, and role-based access controls are essential for instrument logs and pseudonymized patient linkages?
response.answer: For instrument logs and pseudonymized patient linkages, an IRB approval, a Data Use Agreement, secure retention of linkage keys, and strict role-based access controls are essential.

results.title: Electronic Patient Record Systems in Pharmaceutical R&D ...
results.content: | **Meditech** | – Integrated EHR for community and mid-size hospitals (Expanse platform) – Covers inpatient, outpatient, ED, long-term care in one system – Cost-effective and reliable; widely used in smaller healthcare systems – **Major 2026 deployment at 43 HCA Healthcare hospitals** – 2026 roadmap focused on agentic AI and automation | – Supports HL7 FHIR APIs (Greenfield initiative) for data access and app integration () – Standard HL7 v2 interfaces for lab, radiology, ADT, etc., enabling CTMS/LIMS links – Participates in CommonWell/Carequality HIE and TEFCA for cross-organization data sharing – AI-powered tools including Expanse chatbot and MyHealth Assistant () | – Used by many community hospitals that are now contributing data for research (often previously underrepresented populations) – Partnership with IHM to use Meditech EHR data for **health equity research**, giving pharma insight into diverse patient outcomes () – Meditech data being aggregated for RWE (e.g., regional disease trend analysis) by public health and research groups – Some Meditech hospitals participate in industry trials; data can be integrated to sponsor systems via standard interfaces |.
